thread:
support-jen: Customer reported elevated 5xxs and timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west2 (az2). Customer ID: acme-inc. Spike started ~2026-03-16T12:07Z. They see lots of 502/504 and curl traces show connection resets. attaching sample request IDs: rq_01Fxyz, rq_01Fabcd

sre-ryan: Looking. Any repro steps or sample curl/trace?

support-jen: Paste from customer:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' -d '{"model":"redwood-1"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

monitoring-bot: Alert: hosted-api-eu-west2-gateway 5xx rate 18% (threshold 5%) at 2026-03-16T12:08Z. Packet loss metric (egress) spiked to 3.4% in eu-west2-az2.

network-luis: I see BGP withdraws from ASN 64512 affecting eu-west2 transit at ~12:05Z — routes flapped to secondary provider. Packet loss and RTT jump on that path. Collecting traceroutes.

sre-ryan: Can we confirm if requests are failing at edge vs upstream gateway? Olga can you check runtime logs for KV cache timeouts and backend TCP resets?

eng-runtime-olga: Quick grep shows many session resets to backend host gw-eu2-1 around 12:06-12:10Z. Example log:
```
[12:06:34] gw-eu2-1 tcp reset from upstream, err=ECONNRESET
[12:06:35] route latency spike to 132ms, retry=1
```

sre-ryan: That matches. Likely transient provider path causing high retransmits, causing gateway to return 502/504 when kv cache handshake takes too long. Mitigation: fail traffic to eu-west1 region and enable fallback policy for high-5xx.

network-luis: I'll request emergency BGP dampening rollback with the provider and open TAC ticket. In the meantime, can we apply a temporary routing policy to prefer alternate peer? I can push community change.

support-jen: Customer requested ETA. Can we give <1h? They reported service degradation impacting inference jobs.

sre-ryan: ETA estimate: 30-45m to stabilize if provider accepts route fix. Rolling redirect clients from eu-west2 to eu-west1 for affected tenants now.

support-jen: Noted. I'll update customer and request they retry in eu-west1 region. :thumbsup: 

customer-consultant: Thanks, we switched region and errors reduced. We'll keep monitoring.

monitoring-bot: Incident note added: incident-2026-03-16-eu-west2-provider-bgp-flap. Follow-up required: long-term provider SLA discussion.
